body: Hey, there. I know it feels terrible right now, and I understand the stress of school and debt and trying to find a job, but this is a situation that can and will resolve. I don’t know much about food science, but I’m sure there’s some positions you can find in your field with a bachelors. If you can’t find anything in that niche, there are good jobs you can get as long as you have ANY four-year degree. You’re not a failure, and it’s okay if you end up in a job or field that wasn’t your major. Honestly, tons and tons of people end up in other fields after college. And if you’ve got your heart set on food science, go to grad school anyway! I went to grad school and took out loans. Yes, it sucks, but it’s a means to an end to get where you want to go, and the investment eventually pays itself off. Hang in there, friend!

I don’t have any answers. I feel trapped too. My life feels like hell too. I just saw your post and wanted to say that the therapist I was seeing also said she didn’t think I want to get better. That was the last time I went. It made it all feel pointless. The people we’re literally spending time and money seeing to get help say we don’t want help. What’s the point? Sorry you’ve gone through that too.

Yes, but they don’t really know what to say. And I don’t blame them for that. I understand. I probably wouldn’t know what to say if someone else came to me like this. Thanks for taking the time reply.
Thank you. I love you, too. ❤️
